title: Special Episode: Roe v. Wade Is Overturned

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普林。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收看《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客节目。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 回想当年我在黑胶唱片时代夜总会打碟时，你每天晚上都要带上300张你最珍爱的藏品去上班，然后把DJ台

sentences.en: into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成这样一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，摆满了那些美丽而有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜爱的播客平台上收听由爱彼表呈献的《重构者》。

sentences.en: This is Cindy Harper, Daily Producer.
sentences.zh: 我是《每日新闻》制作人辛迪·哈珀。

sentences.en: I am walking down the block
sentences.zh: 我正沿着街区步行

sentences.en: to the Supreme Court of the United States from where my Uber had to drop me off.
sentences.zh: 前往美国最高法院，我的优步只能把我送到这里。

sentences.en: The police presence here is intense.
sentences.zh: 这里的警察戒备森严。

sentences.en: It's the Capitol Police.
sentences.zh: 他们是国会警察。

sentences.en: I mean, shields, face, guards and helmets and all kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 我是说，有防暴盾牌、面罩、头盔和各种装备。

sentences.en: What are your names?
sentences.zh: 请问你们叫什么名字？

sentences.en: My name is Jocabe Torres.
sentences.zh: 我叫霍卡贝·托雷斯。

sentences.en: How old are you?
sentences.zh: 你多大了？

sentences.en: I am 24 years old.
sentences.zh: 我24岁。

sentences.en: Yeah, and are you from the area?
sentences.zh: 好的，你是本地人吗？

sentences.en: I'm from California.
sentences.zh: 我来自加利福尼亚州。

sentences.en: Oh, did you all fly here?
sentences.zh: 哦，你们是坐飞机来的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I flew in here.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是坐飞机来的。

sentences.en: For this?
sentences.zh: 为了这个吗？

sentences.en: Yes, we were expecting the decision to come down and it did come down and we are very happy with the decision.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们一直在等待裁决下达，现在终于下达了，我们对这个裁决非常高兴。

sentences.en: So I didn't want to be involved at the beginning abortion violence sign.
sentences.zh: 所以我一开始不想参与堕胎暴力标语的相关活动。

sentences.en: I see I am the post-Roe generation sign.
sentences.zh: 我看到我是“后罗伊时代”的一代标语。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Can you tell me your name?
sentences.zh: 能告诉我你的名字吗？

sentences.en: It's Sarah Orton-Bypond.
sentences.zh: 我是萨拉·奥顿-拜庞德。

sentences.en: I'm pretty shocked.
sentences.zh: 我感到相当震惊。

sentences.en: I wasn't expecting to come here and see a celebration.
sentences.zh: 我没料到来到这里会看到一场庆祝活动。

sentences.en: I think that's some naivete on my part.
sentences.zh: 我想这有些出於我的天真。

sentences.en: So the overturning of Roe means just a lot of women dying and not having access to safe abortions.
sentences.zh: 所以推翻罗伊案意味着无数女性将失去生命，且无法获得安全的堕胎服务。

sentences.en: And it's really horrifying to see people celebrating here.
sentences.zh: 看到人们在这里庆祝，真的让人感到毛骨悚然。

sentences.en: I'm a mom.
sentences.zh: 我是一位母亲。

sentences.en: I had a hard childbirth and forcing that on people is just a lot and it's really emotional to see this right now.
sentences.zh: 我曾经历过艰难的分娩，把这种痛苦强加给别人实在太沉重了，此时此刻看到这一幕真的很让人情绪崩溃。

sentences.en: And we knew that this was happening and it didn't prepare me for this feeling.
sentences.zh: 我们虽然知道这件事正在发生，但这并没有让我为这种感觉做好心理准备。

sentences.en: It's really hard.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难受。

sentences.en: I just, yeah, sorry.
sentences.zh: 我只是，是的，对不起。

sentences.en: This is a lot.
sentences.zh: 这太让人难以承受了。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a special episode of The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是一期《每日新闻》特别节目。

sentences.en: The Supreme Court has overturned Roe v.
sentences.zh: 最高法院已经推翻了罗伊诉

sentences.en: Wade,
sentences.zh: 韦德案，

sentences.en: eliminating the constitutional right to an abortion after almost 50 years in a decision that will transform American life.
sentences.zh: 在将彻底改变美国人生活的裁决中，在近50年后消除了堕胎的宪法权利。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I just couldn't believe that something like this is happening and this much negative change is happening around me.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信这样的事情正在发生，我身边正在发生如此巨大的负面变化。

sentences.en: I just, I was scared for a second and realizing that this is what's, this is what the future is becoming.
sentences.zh: 我只是，我有一刻感到害怕，意识到这就是，这就是未来的走向。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: It's such an exciting day today to know that we're finally reaching an America that knows that abortion isn't really necessary or needed.
sentences.zh: 今天是如此令人兴奋的一天，得知我们终于迎来了一个认识到堕胎其实并非必不可少的美国。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague,
sentences.zh: 我采访了我的同事、

sentences.en: Supreme Court reporter, Adam Liptak.
sentences.zh: 最高法院记者亚当·利普塔克。

sentences.en: It's Saturday, June 25th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月25日星期六。

sentences.en: Adam, the leak a couple of months ago of this opinion or an earlier version of it really meant that the whole country has known that this was all but inevitable.
sentences.zh: 亚当，几个月前这份意见书或其早期版本的泄露，实际上意味着全国上下都知道这是不可避免的。

sentences.en: And yet, absorbing it all today, it's still a shock and clearly a further fracturing of the country and above all, just a difficult to process level of significance.
sentences.zh: 然而，今天真正接受这一切时，它仍然是一个震撼，显然也是对国家的进一步分裂，最重要的是，其影响深远得让人难以消化。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's one thing to know it could happen and it was odd with the leak because you had a pretty good sense of how it would happen if it happened.
sentences.zh: 是的，知道它可能会发生是一回事，而且泄密事件很奇怪，因为如果真的发生，你很清楚它会如何发生。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But, you know, almost two months have passed.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，将近两个月过去了。

sentences.en: There must have been a lot of activity within the court and certainly people on the abortion rights side held out some hope that the result would be different.
sentences.zh: 法院内部必定发生了很多活动，支持堕胎权的人士肯定也抱有一线希望，认为结果会不同。

sentences.en: So when the decision lands, and it's not only the aversion of the leaked draft, but also concurrences and dissents and 200 plus pages of argument, it really brings home
sentences.zh: 因此，当裁决下达时，不仅泄露的草案被推翻，还有协同意见、反对意见以及长达200多页的论证，这确实让人真切地意识到

sentences.en: that something really big happened in the nation.
sentences.zh: 国家发生了一件极其重大 A的事。

sentences.en: That women's lives, the healthcare system, the political system, even potentially the legitimacy of the Supreme Court, it's all shifted a bit.
sentences.zh: 女性的命运、医疗系统、政治系统，甚至潜在的最高法院的合法性，都发生了一些转变。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: In some cases, shifted a lot.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，转变巨大。

sentences.en: Exactly right, yeah.
sentences.zh: 完全正确，是的。

sentences.en: So let's talk about what exactly the court has done here by reversing Roe.
sentences.zh: 那么我们来谈谈法院通过推翻罗伊案究竟做了什么。

sentences.en: It eliminated a constitutional right to abortion, a right that's been in place for about 50 years, a right that generations of women have assumed that they have.
sentences.zh: 它取消了堕胎的宪法权利，这是一项已存在大约50年的权利，是一代又一代女性认为理所当然拥有的权利。

sentences.en: And so in overruling Roe, the court said, we're going to stay out of this.
sentences.zh: 因此，在推翻罗伊案时，法院表示：我们不介入此事。

sentences.en: The Constitution has nothing to say about this.
sentences.zh: 宪法对此没有任何说法。

sentences.en: States can do what they like.
sentences.zh: 各州想怎么做就怎么做。

sentences.en: If they want to ban abortion, they can.
sentences.zh: 如果他们想禁止堕胎，他们可以。

sentences.en: If they want to allow abortion, they can.
sentences.zh: 如果他们想允许堕胎，他们可以。

sentences.en: If Congress wants to act in this area, it can.
sentences.zh: 如果国会想在这方面采取行动，它也可以。

sentences.en: This is for the people's political, elected representatives, and not for judges.
sentences.zh: 这是由人民的政治选举代表决定的，而不是由法官决定。

sentences.en: And Adam, in doing that, in putting abortion in the hands of states, state lawmakers, what kind of parameters or guidance did the Supreme Court leave in place to guide
sentences.zh: 亚当，在这样做时，在将堕胎权交由各州和州议员决定时，最高法院留下了什么样的参数或指导来指导

sentences.en: what happens next with abortion law?
sentences.zh: 接下来堕胎法会发生什么？

sentences.en: The majority opinion tells us essentially nothing about what kinds of abortion restrictions may be proper.
sentences.zh: 多数派意见基本上没有告诉我们什么样的堕胎限制可能是适当的。

sentences.en: They certainly suggest that you can ban abortion from the moment of conception.
sentences.zh: 他们当然暗示你可以从受孕那一刻起就禁止堕胎。

sentences.en: And the live questions then are, well, what are the exceptions?
sentences.zh: 那么现实的问题是：有什么例外情况？

sentences.en: What about the life of the mother?
sentences.zh: 母亲的生命怎么办？

sentences.en: What about the health of the mother?
sentences.zh: 母亲的健康怎么办？

sentences.en: What about rape?
sentences.zh: 强奸怎么办？

sentences.en: What about incest?
sentences.zh: 乱伦怎么办？

sentences.en: What about fetal abnormalities?
sentences.zh: 胎儿异常怎么办？

sentences.en: And you can stare at Justice Alito's majority opinion for a long time and really get almost no guidance.
sentences.zh: 你可以盯着阿利托大法官的多数派意见看很久，却几乎得不到任何指导。

sentences.en: And that will be the subject of further litigation.
sentences.zh: 这将是未来诉讼的主题。

sentences.en: But you have the sense that many of those potential exceptions are not constitutionally required in the eyes of the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 但你有一种感觉，在最高法院看来，许多潜在的例外并不是宪法所必须的。

sentences.en: The main exception I would anticipate
sentences.zh: 我预计主要的例外情况

sentences.en: is the life of the mother.
sentences.zh: 是母亲的生命。

sentences.en: But even that is not addressed in so many words.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，也没有用这么明确的词汇来解决。

sentences.en: So this ruling allows for, in theory, some of the most restrictive possible bans against abortion.
sentences.zh: 因此，理论上这项裁决允许实施一些最严厉的堕胎禁令。

sentences.en: immediately.
sentences.zh: 立即生效。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we've talked, Adam, about the states that have laws in place that anticipated this day and this moment, so-called trigger laws, that would automatically do just that,
sentences.zh: 亚当，我们讨论过那些已经制定了法律以应对这一天和这一刻的州，也就是所谓的触发法，它们会自动做到这一点，

sentences.en: would ban abortion.
sentences.zh: 即禁止堕胎。

sentences.en: How quickly will those laws now go into effect?
sentences.zh: 这些法律现在多快会生效？

sentences.en: Well, they will vary depending on what the text of the laws say.
sentences.zh: 这取决于法律文本的具体内容。

sentences.en: But the very notion of a trigger law is as soon as the court overrules Roe, the law is meant to spring into effect.
sentences.zh: 但触发法的概念就是，一旦法院推翻罗伊案，法律就会立即生效。

sentences.en: Now, some of them may have some time delays in their text, but there's also a practical point here,
sentences.zh: 现在，其中一些法律的文本中可能会有一些时间延迟，但这里还有一个实际问题，

sentences.en: Michael.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔。

sentences.en: An abortion clinic in a state with a trigger law, knowing that the law is going to come into effect tomorrow or next week or next month, may well be very cautious about continuing
sentences.zh: 在一个拥有触发法的州，一家堕胎诊所知道该法律将在明天、下周或下个月生效，他们可能会非常谨慎地继续

sentences.en: to perform abortions because they won't be sure whether there's criminal liability attached to what used to be a constitutional right.
sentences.zh: 实施堕胎，因为他们不确定以前属于宪法权利的行为现在是否会带来刑事责任。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: So in other words, there may be a chilling effect that pauses abortion in these states even before the trigger law actually goes into effect.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，可能会有一种寒蝉效应，甚至在触发法真正生效之前，就暂停了这些州的堕胎服务。

sentences.en: Exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So do you expect abortion rights groups to try to slow this all down with legal actions, with lawsuits?
sentences.zh: 那么，你预计争取堕胎权的组织会试图通过法律行动和诉讼来延缓这一切吗？

sentences.en: Yes, of course.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: There are talented and committed litigators on the other side of this issue who will make every argument available to them to try to maintain some access to abortion
sentences.zh: 这个问题对立面有一群才华横溢、坚定不移的诉讼律师，他们会利用所有可用的论据，试图在那些试图禁止堕胎的多数红州中

sentences.en: in the largely red states that seek to ban them, but their legal tools are limited.
sentences.zh: 维持某种堕胎渠道，但他们的法律工具是有限的。

sentences.en: Because Roe is gone, so their chances of success are very narrow?
sentences.zh: 因为罗伊案已经不复存在，所以他们成功的几率非常渺茫？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There may be arguments out there that I haven't thought of, but you would seem to have a vanishingly limited chance of success in lawsuits challenging most of these abortion bans.
sentences.zh: 可能会有一些我没有想到的法律论据，但在挑战大多数此类堕胎禁令的诉讼中，你成功的几率似乎微乎其微。

sentences.en: So let's turn, Adam, to the justices' rationale for doing this, their opinions released on Friday.
sentences.zh: 亚当，让我们转而谈谈大法官们这样做的理由，他们在周五发布的意见书。

sentences.en: In his leaked opinion that we got a glimpse of a couple months ago,
sentences.zh: 在他几个月前泄露的意见书中，

sentences.en: Justice Alito basically argued that Roe v.
sentences.zh: 阿利托大法官基本上认为罗伊诉

sentences.en: Wade should be tossed out because the Constitution makes no mention of abortion.
sentences.zh: 韦德案应该被抛弃，因为宪法根本没有提及堕胎。

sentences.en: So it's pretty hard to find a right to it.
sentences.zh: 所以很难从中找到堕胎的权利。

sentences.en: And he went on to say that previous justices, knowing that fact, strained really hard to find a right to an abortion within the 14th Amendment's promise that you can't take away
sentences.zh: 他接着说，前几任大法官明知这一事实，却极力试图在第十四修正案关于不能剥夺

sentences.en: people's right to liberty without due process, which is a major basis for Roe.
sentences.zh: 人民正当程序下享有的自由权利的承诺中寻找堕胎权，这是罗伊案的主要基础。

sentences.en: And Alito said that was a stretch and not a legitimate basis for creating a right to an abortion.
sentences.zh: 阿利托表示，这是一种牵强附会，并不是确立堕胎权的合法基础。

sentences.en: How much of that argument and logic was reflected in Alito's final opinion today, Adam?
sentences.zh: 阿利托今天最终的意见书中在多大程度上反映了这种论点和逻辑，亚当？

sentences.en: You know, I haven't done an edit-trace comparison one to the other, but in reading the new one, it sounded very much like the old one, only with the addition of some responses
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我没有做过新旧版本的逐字比对，但在阅读新版本时，听起来和旧版本非常相似，只是增加了一些对协同意见和

sentences.en: to concurring and dissenting opinions.
sentences.zh: 反对意见的回应。

sentences.en: But the basic structure, language, tone of the draft
sentences.zh: 但阿利托草案意见的基本结构、语言、基调

sentences.en: Alito opinion is maintained in the final opinion.
sentences.zh: 在最终意见书中得以保留。

sentences.en: And your account of the basic reasoning is right.
sentences.zh: 你对基本推理的描述是正确的。

sentences.en: He says that you can't read a right to abortion into the Constitution because the word doesn't appear there.
sentences.zh: 他说你不能在宪法中解读出堕胎权，因为宪法中没有出现这个词。

sentences.en: And the main hook that abortion rights advocates look to, the protection of liberty and the due process clause of the 14th Amendment doesn't work either because he says
sentences.zh: 而堕胎权倡导者寻找的主要依据——第十四修正案的正当程序条款对自由的保护也行不通，因为他说

sentences.en: when that Civil War era amendment was ratified, the people who ratified it didn't think they were creating a right to abortion in fact, he says, most states made abortion
sentences.zh: 当那个内战时期的修正案被批准时，批准它的人并不认为他们是在创造堕胎权，事实上，他说，当时大多数州都将堕胎

sentences.en: a crime back then.
sentences.zh: 定为犯罪。

sentences.en: So the Alito opinion was not particularly surprising because we had this preview of it and it's not terribly different from the preview.
sentences.zh: 所以阿利托的意见并不是特别令人惊讶，因为我们之前已经看过了预览，而且它与预览没有太大区别。

sentences.en: But there were other opinions from conservative justices, concurring opinions, and they kind of illustrated that the right, although there were five votes for this outcome,
sentences.zh: 但保守派大法官们还有其他意见，即协同意见，它们某种程度上说明了这项权利，尽管有五票支持这一结果，

sentences.en: are not wholly united.
sentences.zh: 但并非完全团结一致。

sentences.en: Explain that.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下。

sentences.en: And also, explain why you're saying that there were only
sentences.zh: 还有，解释一下你为什么说只有

sentences.en: five votes for this outcome because
sentences.zh: 五票支持这一结果，因为

sentences.en: we are all reporting that this was a six to three vote to overturn Roe versus Wade.
sentences.zh: 我们都在报道说这是一场六比三的投票结果，推翻了罗伊诉韦德案。

sentences.en: Yeah, so this is quite interesting.
sentences.zh: 是的，这非常有趣。

sentences.en: This is a story about Chief Justice
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于首席大法官

sentences.en: John Roberts.
sentences.zh: 约翰·罗伯茨的故事。

sentences.en: He doesn't join the Alito opinion.
sentences.zh: 他没有加入阿利托的意见。

sentences.en: There are five votes for the Alito opinion.
sentences.zh: 支持阿利托意见的有五票。

sentences.en: And Chief Justice Roberts says, no, thank you.
sentences.zh: 首席大法官罗伯茨则表示：不用了，谢谢。

sentences.en: I have my own ideas about how we should have resolved this case.
sentences.zh: 关于我们应该如何解决这个案件，我有我自己的想法。

sentences.en: And he has a kind of half measure.
sentences.zh: 他采取了一种折中的半套措施。

sentences.en: He doesn't want to go as far as Alito and the other conservatives went.
sentences.zh: 他不想像阿利托和其他保守派那样走得那么远。

sentences.en: The question in the case, of course, is whether Mississippi can enact a law banning most abortions after 15 weeks of pregnancy.
